HD DVD surrenders the format war


     The two-year war between HD DVD and Blu-ray officially ended early Tuesday morning as Toshiba waved the white flag and declared it would stop producing HD DVD products. The company said it would continue support for Toshiba HD DVD products and would "continue to assess the position of notebook PCs with integrated HD DVD drives" going forward. R.I.P. Robert Vamosi
